<function name="PreAutoRefresh" parent="PANEL" type="hook">
	<description>
Only works on elements defined with <page>derma.DefineControl</page> and only if the panel has **AllowAutoRefresh** set to true.

Called when <page>derma.DefineControl</page> is called with this panel's class name before applying changes to this panel.

See also <page>PANEL:PostAutoRefresh</page>
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
</function>
